On the first day, she begged at the door of his company;
On the second day, she staged a car accident scam on him;
On the third day, she blocked him in an alley, with a face of great mercy –
“I really like your money, I hope it becomes mine.”
“So I’ve decided to marry you.”
She coughed –
“Are you going to voluntarily be conquered by me, or be forcibly conquered by me?”
?
[Story background is Earth in 2023 AD]

73084.synopsis:
“I have something to say.”
It wasn’t a mutter. Elaine gazed earnestly at her fiancé, but he didn’t even turn his head.
“It’s important, Blake.”
He narrowed his eyes as if annoyed, exhaling a sigh.
If she couldn’t say it this time, there might never be another chance. She had only one year left.
“Please break off the engagement, Your Grace.”
“If you’re trying to attract my attention again, please stop. I’m tired of it now.”
As if a perfect mask had shattered, Blake’s face contorted. To think she had worked so hard to marry such a person.
Suppressing the desire to flee, Elaine said with difficulty, “Break off the engagement. Really.”
Now, I won’t love you anymore.

74108.synopsis:
Reborn in 1972 in a Rural Family – A Life You Never Knew.
Experience a life you’ve never imagined, reborn in the rural setting of 1972. Despite the scarcity of clothing and food and the presence of outstanding individuals, the protagonist, armed with a unique space, ensures a worry-free life for their family.
This work takes you back to the era of production teams, offering a taste of a different kind of life. Embrace the transformation from being a laid-back individual to engaging in agriculture – a tale of turning the tide.

77436.synopsis:
How could I make my voice be heard?
“The person I want to hear the most from is not opening her mouth.”
“……..”
“My wife just sits quietly all the time.”
Escallion moved with heavy steps towards Belladonna, who was sitting still on the bed. Then, he forcefully grabbed her chin and lifted her head up.
‘How can I speak?’
“……….”
Looking at her shaking eyes, he clicked his tongue, relaxed his hand holding her chin, and turned around. Her eyes were filled with Escalion’s massive back muscles as he picked up the gown that had fallen haphazardly on the floor and put it on.
“…Hiccup.”
Oh no! Belladonna closed her eyes tightly, in despair. I hope he didn’t hear it…
“Hiccup? Was it you?”
He heard. This is bad. I hope he doesn’t come here. Please leave… Escallion slowly turned his head. His dark, shining eyes fixed on Belladonna.
“Did you just make a sound?”
His lips curled dangerously upwards.
‘The last Saint of Astanya.’
‘Astanya’s smile.’
‘A living portrait of Astanya.’
When I opened my eyes, I found myself the only daughter of the Pope, praised by everyone, and a Saint who could not speak.
“…Why do I have such a good voice?”

78460.synopsis:
Shi Ye × Sheng Xia
Tsundere top, slow-witted bottom.
A somewhat unconventional band story, not set in the entertainment industry, with a seven-year age gap between the main characters. Both protagonists are a bit childish and strange, telling the boring story of two neurotic and whimsical people falling in love. There may be many triggering points, so enter the story with caution.

79996.synopsis: On the night before his college graduation, Wu Xiaoyin, lost consciousness amidst the loud cheers of his classmates during a big sale, filled with expectation for his new life. Little did he know that the next morning, he would be greeted by a magnificent and colorful giant tiger upon waking up. Furthermore, this tiger performed a stunning act of transformation. The sight of it overwhelmed Wu Xiaoyin, who had just woken up, to the point where he once again lost consciousness. And then, the big tiger dragged little female Wu Xiaoyin back to its den to give birth to cubs. Ha ha!
associated_names: 穿越兽人大陆的幸福生活

81276.synopsis:
Thanos put on the Infinity Gauntlet, which was embedded with six stones, and snapped his fingers! Whoosh whoosh whoosh~~~ half of all living beings in the universe turned to dust!
Under the protection of a gem that was so red it was almost black and purple, Qi Jun was completely unharmed.
And then, he too stretched out his hand and snapped his fingers.
Snap! Whoosh whoosh whoosh~~~ all the beings that had just turned to dust in the universe came back unharmed. Thanos widened his eyes and snapped his fingers again.
Snap! Whoosh whoosh whoosh~~~ slowly, Qi Jun snapped his fingers again. Snap! Whoosh whoosh whoosh~~~ the universe was restored to its original state.
Thanos looked at the now shattered Infinity Gauntlet, “Damn it!”

82556.synopsis:
“I want you to live with me as my wife for just one year. Of course, you must bring that child with you.”
A soon-to-be unemployed and deranged prince proposes to Hailey, a single woman with a child. However, it seems the prince is actually targeting her five-year-old nephew.
“I’ve been looking for a woman just like you. The perfect ideal I’ve dreamed of.”
“Crazy bastard.”
Hailey ends up entering a one-year contract marriage with the mad prince. With her nephew Theo, she heads to the mysterious island of Winchester, determined to repay the prince’s grace like a grateful magpie. In the seemingly peaceful Winchester, mages and forest fairies start appearing.
“Daddy Axel.”
Her nephew Theo keeps calling the prince ‘daddy.’
“In a harmonious family, physical affection is a must.”
The mad prince’s flirting is going off the rails!
A chaotic journey of the three musketeers who seem like a family but aren’t, as they enter the grand duchy of Winchester!
associated_names: The Soon-to-Be Unemployed Prince Covets My Nephew
백수가 된 왕자가 내 조카를 탐낸다

84092.synopsis:
My husband, Xie Wu Chen, was a genius sword cultivator, while I was just a mortal.
Xie Wu Chen despised foolish people.
To catch up with him, I worked hard at cultivation, but he remained indifferent:
“You have no spiritual roots, it’s a waste of effort.”
Later, he ascended, and I remarried.
On the day of my wedding, he descended to the mortal realm, his sword placed against my husband’s neck:
“Do you really want to marry this useless person?”
I stood before the sword, holding my mortal husband’s hand, and looked straight at Xie Wu Chen:
“Yes, because he never thought I was s*upid.”
Xie Wu Chen sneered:
“Just because of that?”
I nodded seriously:
“Just because of that.”

85884.synopsis:
I’ve reincarnated as the maid of the female lead in an R-19 tragic novel.
Saving the injured villain had set the stage for my beloved lady’s life to spiral into chaos. But I couldn’t let that happen. I’ll protect my lady!
I hid the villain, treated him, and made sure he left so he wouldn’t cross paths with my lady again. Yet, somehow, the villain returned to our estate.
“You can’t meet my lady, so you might as well turn around and leave.”
“I don’t know what you’re talking about. I’m here to see you, Claire.”
It turns out the villain was looking for me.
“Why me?”
“Because I’ve fallen in love with you.”
It seems the villain has gone mad.

87420.synopsis:
Descendants of transmigrators—five genius girls possessing the power of gods. Capturing their hearts is the key to transcending humanity! But they seem to have been dead for decades, making them uncapturable?
“They’re just dead, aren’t they? Just dig up their graves and pull them out of their coffins. Excuse me, but we necromancers really can do whatever we want.” —by the Necromancer, Abyss
associated_names: 本死灵术士要攻略已死的美少女们

91772.synopsis: My childhood friend of 13 years suddenly started treating me differently. Why on earth?

92028.synopsis:
She was a secret guard, codenamed 37, later named Qingge by Ning Wang.
One day, she narrowly escaped death and was sent out to recover from her injuries. On the way, someone approached her, claiming she resembled the young lady he served. The young lady was suffering from a chronic illness, and he asked her to take her place in the wedding, hiding the truth from the groom for five months. The man offered her a generous sum of silver notes, and Qingge, being greedy, accepted.
But what she never expected was that the fiancée’s groom turned out to be none other than her master, Ning Wang…
Fortunately, no one knew the face of the secret guards, except for Heaven, Earth, and their Pavilion Master. Ning Wang had no idea. Qingge successfully hid her identity and cautiously played the role of a Wangfei.
Ning Wang was extraordinarily handsome but had a violent temper. One day, while investigating a traitor, he harshly interrogated all the secret guards. One of them ended up being punished for a trivial matter, receiving a hundred whip lashes, leaving the ground stained with blood. Ning Wang remained indifferent.
The Emperor arranged a marriage for Ning Wang with the legitimate daughter of the presitigious Xiahou clan of Ganliang. The Wangfei was gentle, charming, and pure in nature. Initially, Ning Wang was indifferent and cautious but eventually fell for her.
After ten months of pregnancy, the Wangfei gave birth to a son. When she returned after a visit to her natal family, Ning Wang gripped her by the throat and coldly demanded, “Where is this prince’s Wangfei?”
Though the woman before him looked alike, she was not her.
It was then that he realized the Wangfei he had shared his life with was a fake, brought in by the Xiahou family with money!
In his fury, Ning Wang unleashed a bloodbath.
Afterward, he searched everywhere for that woman, but despite turning the world upside down, he could not find her.
Three years passed, and Ning Wang’s initial rage and hatred turned into silence and contemplation, eventually giving way to quiet coldness.
Until one day, under the dim light of the waning moon, he gazed at the fallen phoenix tree leaves at his feet, covering the elongated shadow of the secret guard behind him.
In a low voice, he asked, “It’s you, isn’t it?”

94844.synopsis:
Bliss, both a villainess and a catalyst for the main characters’ meeting, was destined to die today. Her mu*derer would be none other than her own husband, Marquis Caelan Adrian.
Around her neck lay her husband’s gift—the very thing meant to take her life.
Without a chance to avoid it, Caelan’s hand reached out in an instant and wrapped around Bliss’s nape. She tensed up at the feeling of the large hand on her neck.
“I’ll put it on for you.”
The cold touch seemed to drain every bit of warmth from her body, leaving Bliss breathless. As she braced herself for death,
‘What’s going on?’
Something impossible happened. Even though the poisoned necklace was clearly constricting Bliss’s neck, her breath didn’t stop.
* * *
“Caelan, please don’t kill me.”
Bliss met his gaze directly as she spoke each word with determination. While she pleaded for her life and promised to end her wicked ways, Caelan merely watched her in silence.

95356.synopsis:
The villainess, Clea Odoi, who was cursed to live a short life.
The curse can be lifted if she receives true love from someone else. But no one loves her. Not her fiancé, nor her friends, not even her family.
So she gives up on everything and just waits for the day she will die. Then he approaches her. Edmund Wilhelm, the Crown Prince of the Empire.
“Edmund, I have one last request.”
Seeing him approach first and extend his hand, Clea impulsively dreams of a one-night escape.
“Don’t regret it.”
“Regret? I don’t do that.”
Without knowing what consequences that one night would bring.
associated_names: 시한부인 줄 알고 남주와 첫날밤을 보냈습니다

95612.synopsis:
A 24-year-old college student buried in assignments, Yoon Se-ah. When I open my eyes, I’m in an unfamiliar place, dressed in rags and standing in the rain.
In front of me appears a duke who, saying I resemble his lost daughter, wants to adopt me.
It seems I’ve somehow possessed a character in a regretful family story.
But then…
“Try calling me ‘big brother.’”
With a strange eldest brother.
“Your innocent and cute expression doesn’t work on me.”
“Pardon? I didn’t do anything….”
“It won’t work.”
The second brother, who only spouts nonsense, becomes obsessed with me.
__________________________________________________________________
Then, I meet potential male leads.
“An angel’s presence sparkles around you.”
Is this his way of introducing himself?
A candidate priest who looks just like an angel.
“You’re welcome to marry me.”
My childhood friend, who out of nowhere tells me I can marry him.
“Finally found you. Thanks to you, I spent a few extra hours in that pit.”
Even the Crown Prince, whom I purposely avoided, is searching for me.
“INTJ? I’d prefer to be an F.”
“Unless the archduke  loses his memory, is reborn in a harmonious family, and develops healthy hobbies and relationships, changing his MBTI is difficult.”
Not even beating up the creator would help….
The northern archduke fixates on the MBTI I taught him without much thought.
Something is definitely off-kilter here.
Can I really accomplish my goal of securing a fortune before the real daughter returns, by finding the main male lead?

96124.synopsis:
The sensation of floating on water. The smell of rusted iron. A hutch surrounded on all sides.
“What is this now?”
A face as cold as the winter air.
“What I was supposed to receive was…”
A scar above his eyelid and,
“Not this kind of mutt.”
Fierce eyes that looked as if they could devour someone.
“…Ah.”
And the salty scent of the sea.
This was a world Jung Heeyeon had never seen before.
Not even once.
—
Opening his eyes inside an empty container, Jung Heeyeon follows a man he’s never met before without resistance, simply because the man is a dominant alpha.
Meanwhile, Director Yeon receives a call from Chief Nam, who sent him a “gift,” and learns that the omega in the container is related to Chairman Jung, a figure from a dark past.
“Heeyeon.”
“… Yes?”
“Are you nineteen years old?”
“Yes.”
“So you’re a baby.”
“I’m not a baby.”
“Babies usually hate being called a baby.”
“It’s not like that… I mean, I’m nineteen…?”
At this earnest reply, Director Yeon lets out a soft laugh.
“You’re going to be a handful, aren’t you?”
“I’ll try… not to be a burden.”
“Don’t worry, Heeyeon.”
“……”
“I like things that require a lot of attention.”
The man, who brought Jung Heeyeon into his house, gives a kind suggestion.
“Should I call it a deal instead?”
“A deal?”
“Because I need you.”

97660.synopsis:
What can your college major do for you if you transmigrate to ancient times?
Jiang Lili and her classmates were visiting their high school teacher when the bus they were on exploded, causing the entire class to transmigrate—with their group chat intact! Each classmate found themselves in unique roles, from a nomadic khan to an imperial physician.
But Jiang Lili had the worst luck, becoming the unfortunate princess consort who started her journey exiled to a desolate island, far from her classmates’ help. On the brink of starvation, she was struck by a soda can that fell from her bamboo basket—only to discover her basket could connect to the modern world!
The culprit behind the soda can? None other than Zhang Xiaopang, their class’s infamous “king of tardiness,” who, true to form, had been late to the reunion with their teacher.
With connections spanning the ancient realm and modern supplies from her basket, Jiang Lili thrived on the exile road. Meanwhile, her conniving stepsister and cruel father assumed she was suffering on the island. In reality, Jiang Lili was enjoying a luxurious island retreat while helping Zhang Xiaopang revive his family’s seafood business, which had been devastated by nuclear wastewater contamination.
…
The prince of the Zhaoping Marquisate, Xin Che, was a man of unparalleled beauty and talent. At sixteen, he quelled a rebellion for the emperor and guarded the borders for five years, only to return and find his younger sister sent to the steppes as a political bride.
Falsely accused upon his return, his entire family was exiled. Disheartened by the emperor’s ruthlessness, Xin Che resigned himself to death on the road to exile.
But then, his unfamiliar princess consort began conjuring miraculous items like a deity, helping them survive every hardship. Good news followed one after another:
His sister, sent to the grasslands, was now revered by thousands.
His aunt, once dying in the cold palace, had been saved by a divine healer.
Loyal followers scattered across the realm were aided by mysterious, powerful forces.
On the day Xin Che returned to the capital, he presented the imperial seal and offered the entire kingdom as his bride price.
associated_names: 全班穿越，世子妃流放荒地封神了

98684.synopsis:
The stage rehearsal for the New Year’s Eve event had just finished, and the lights dimmed, leaving the seating area in darkness.
As Bian Li was walking with her team, she accidentally tripped near other artists’ seats and ended up sitting on someone’s lap.
She looked up and met a pair of slightly amused dark eyes. The owner of those warm legs propped his head up with one hand and said in a lazy tone, “Throwing yourself at me, huh? Do you like me?”
That evening, Bian Li’s name trended on the internet due to an insider’s leak.
————
Young and famous, arrogant and unruly, as the top figure in the industry, He Yunxing has never taken anyone seriously.
After clarifying the rumors, fans insisted the two were not related with each other at all and could never spark a relationship.
Later, on a variety show where idol groups send their members to participate, the director’s team did a live broadcast surprise check, knocking on Bian Li’s door.
To their surprise, it was He Yunxing, shirtless and sleepy, who opened it. His half-closed eyes showed a hint of irritation, “What is it?”
At that moment, a soft, sweet female voice came from inside, “Xingxing, are you done? Come back and keep me company.”
The director’s team was shocked. 
The live broadcast room exploded.

99196.synopsis:
After completing the cannon fodder quick transmigration mission, Gu Qing won a vacation opportunity.  
However, when she woke up, a message appeared in front of her.  
【Doomsday game loading…】  
【Doomsday game loaded, merging into the game world】  
【Friendly reminder: Evolution failed, Earth destroyed. Survivors, please strive to survive.】  
Gu Qing: System? Is this… the vacation world?  
System: World connection error. This world is in the process of evolving its civilization. The host will enter the game world to survive.  
Gu Qing: Can I still be a lazy fish?  
System: Yes, I’ll give you a piece of land.  
—
After receiving the land, Gu Qing just wanted to lie back and do nothing, but before she knew it, she had made the land more and more lively.  
Surviving humans on Earth: Lord, long live!  
Native residents: Lord saved us.  
Goblins: Lord freed us.  
Orcs: …  
Elves: …  
Dwarves: …
associated_names: 开局一块地：我在异界搞基建

101244.synopsis:
The life of a villainess in fiction: Reincarnated as a villainous noble lady, serving as a stepping stone for the protagonist on their journey, the target of a maid’s revenge, the stepsister whose half-sister had taken everything that rightfully belonged to her, and the princess who had cared for her over the years eventually gave up in frustration.
The life of a villainess in reality: Cleaning up after the protagonist’s mess whenever he disappears. In place of the protagonist, teaching the maid not to constantly defy her master. Holding a contract in her hands, the half-sister said, “For just a small price, this territory can be yours—quite the bargain, don’t you think?”
The charming and adorable princess feeds you grapes one by one, reminding herself not to be too greedy; otherwise, she won’t be feeding this mouth next time.
Isn’t there something wrong with this situation?! 
Where’s the protagonist? Where’s the holy sword-wielding protagonist?! I could really use a hand right now!
“Holy sword? Is this the one you’re referring to? Dear… Master.” The guardian knight with the holy sword in hand corners Liana, revealing an eerie, unsettling smirk.
associated_names: The Villainous Noblewoman Is About to Be Forced into Love, Isn’t This Wrong?
恶役千金要被强制爱，这不对吧？

102012.synopsis:
I saved the world and died.
As the strongest hunter, the only thing I secretly wished for was one thing.
‘I want to be buried in cute things and live.’
After reincarnation, what I obtained was a cute appearance and a magical pen.
I wanted to live peacefully in the amusement park that I diligently created with my lacking drawing skills, but…
“Strange creatures are appearing in a dungeon that suddenly appeared!”
“A little girl is trapped in the dungeon?!”
“Little one! I’ll save you!”
For some reason, people are destroying my precious amusement park.
“Waaaah! Don’t break my amusement park, you crazy bastards!”

102780.synopsis:
Twenty years ago, a dungeon appeared in Hachioji City.
Eiji Aikawa, the ‘Swordless Hero’ who defeated the final boss and unlocked the dungeon where unknown resources lay, hid his achievements and worked as a corporate drone for a subcontractor under Japan Dungeon, Inc.
Despite being S-rank, he lacked the privilege of carrying a sword, which led to occasional scorn. Still, he carried out his duties without complaint.
One day, Mii, the niece of a former comrade, approached him, asking to be his disciple.
“Please, old man! Do dungeon streams with me!”
Eiji agreed under the condition that it would be a one-time thing. However, upon returning to his former battlefield, he saw that it had become nothing more than a playground for corrupt elites and a den of dirty money-making schemes.
“A dungeon isn’t your playground. It’s not some filthy business venture, either.”
This is the story of a former hero, now hiding his past, who unintentionally finds himself in the spotlight again as he coaches a group of middle school girls on their adventures.
associated_names: Once Upon a Time, the "No Blade" in Last Dungeon.
『無刀』のおっさん、実はラスダン攻略済み

106876.synopsis: Shen Xingyang was deceived in his previous life and ended up with a situation where he could only commit su*cide to break the situation. Once he was reborn, he must make the person who planned everything behind the scenes pay the price.

107900.synopsis:
I woke up as the villain in a romance simulation game my younger sister loved.
Not just any villain, but Ranshel—the servant who torments one of the capture targets, Zavad, only to meet a miserable end.
“Eunhye, your brother is absolutely screwed…”
To return to my original world in a healthy body, I need to die at Zavad’s hands, just like in the game.
But from my so-called father, the duke, to my stepmother who entered the family later, and even the hidden eyes of the imperial family—
There are way too many villains in this game besides Ranshel, and for Zavad, every single moment of his life is a crisis.
If I want to die at Zavad’s hands, doesn’t that mean he has to survive first?
In the end, Ranshel finds himself in a situation where he must protect Zavad from other villains—
Only to betray him in the end and die.
* * *
“…Well, that works out for us. There’s no chance we’ll ever come to cherish each other anyway.”
Ranshel smiled.
Wasn’t that a good thing?
Their relationship was nothing more than a contractual exchange.
He would help Zavad become the head of his family, and in return, he’d receive an enormous sum of gold.
Until Zavad gained enough power, he’d rely on Ranshel’s help, and when he could finally use his wealth freely, he’d pay him back.
That was all there was to it.
Zavad must have had similar thoughts because he curled his lips into a smirk, though his expression remained displeased.
“Obviously. Why would I ever waste affection on someone as filthy as you, a commoner?”
Filthy. Commoner.
He put particular emphasis on those words.
It was almost funny—his tone was so refined that even an insult didn’t quite sound like one.
Ranshel knew he should laugh, but for some reason, the laughter didn’t come easily.
So he forced himself to smile, tugging at his lips deliberately.
“Right. Just like I have no intention of serving you with body and soul, you shouldn’t go around developing unnecessary feelings for me either. Just thinking about it is unpleasant.”
Zavad scoffed in disbelief.
“How ridiculous. Worry about yourself first. And stop staring at my face like some lovesick fool.”

108924.synopsis:
Just as the title suggests.
This is the story of a protagonist who suddenly turns into a horse girl one day and, together with her trainer, strives to become the strongest stayer!
associated_names: ゆるふわ芦毛のクソかわウマ娘になってトレーナーを勘違いさせたい

110204.synopsis:
At nineteen, Fang Li’s world crumbled—his father vanished after embezzling all the funds from the local mine, leaving him hunted by desperate workers. On the brink of death, it was Qin Weidong, a boy he’d taken in, who saved his life and helped him escape the grim gray mountains.
In the 1990s, as China gradually opened up its mining sector, the two boys, once penniless, began carving their paths. With unmatched intellect and careful planning, Qin Weidong rose to become the general manager of a state-owned mining conglomerate, building his wealth from scratch.
Fang Li, meanwhile, was discovered by a talent scout while working at a music shop. Just as his dreams of a musical career were within reach, he was blindsided by a shocking truth: the man who had belonged only to him for the past decade—Qin Weidong—was actually the long-lost son of one of the most powerful men in Jin province?! 
[Small Theater] 
Entertainment gossip went wild: Fang Li, the breakout star who debuted last year, only rose so fast and won so many awards because he had a super-rich “male sponsor” backing him up.
One shady tabloid even followed him late at night and claimed he was just a spoiled kept boy—humiliated in a parking garage for three whole hours without daring to fight back.
But those juicy headlines disappeared in less than half a day. The editor of the magazine was scared out of his mind, and from then on, no one in the press dared dig into Fang Li’s private life again.
What they didn’t know? There was no “sponsor.” That was just his childhood sweetheart, to whom he’d pledged himself long ago.
[One Night, Backstage at a Concert] 
The assistant remained frozen in place as the sounds of smashing glass and overturned chairs echoed through the dressing room.
“That damn Qin Weidong! He’s so absurdly petty! I didn’t smile during my concert and he thinks I’m mourning someone?! How am I supposed to go on stage like this?”
As the assistant tried to calm the star and fix his powder, the phone rang again at the worst possible time.
The “scandalized” singer grabbed the phone and snapped: “Qin Weidong, you bastard! Get your ass over here right now!!”
associated_names: 九零年代之我的老公是矿业大亨

110972.synopsis:
When Lang Bai was a child, Yuan Cheng thought he was a rare gem—gentle, affectionate, and deeply caring.
But as Lang Bai grew older, Yuan Cheng slowly realized that behind that beautiful face was a heart naturally cold and indifferent.
Yuan Cheng raised the boy himself, carefully shaping every detail—his looks, his personality, what he wore, what he ate, even how long he grew his hair and what clothes he put on—everything was decided by Yuan Cheng.
In the end, he molded this beautiful youth into the perfect lover, just the way he had always dreamed.
After all, isn’t that every man’s fantasy?

111228.synopsis:
Bodam, newly assigned as the guide for the notoriously infamous Attack Team 3, once again dreams of quitting.
Enduring constant disrespect and cold shoulders from four very different a**holes,
He’s only held on for the sake of his paycheck—
until one day,
He wins the lottery.
“Goodbye, everyone!”
With a heart full of relief and a resignation letter in hand,
Bodam is ready to say farewell forever, grateful only that it’s over and hoping to never see their faces again.
Can he successfully escape from the slightly crazy—or completely insane—espers of Attack Team 3?

114556.synopsis:
After an accident, Li Chu transmigrated into an entertainment circle ABO romance novel she had just finished reading.
Unfortunately, Li Chu transmigrated into the role of a cannon fodder character who was jealous of the female lead, and she arrived right at the scene where the original owner was about to drug the female lead and take compromising photos of her.
The female lead appeared to be a Beta on the surface, but Li Chu knew she was actually an undifferentiated Omega. After being drugged, she would awaken, become universally adored, and start a sweet and satisfying story arc, while the cannon fodder who drugged her would meet a very miserable end.
Thinking of the cannon fodder’s fate, Li Chu looked at the drugged water in her hand that hadn’t yet been given to the female lead, and resolutely drank it herself, not leaving a single sip for the female lead.
Li Chu originally thought everything would be fine this way, but as a result, amidst her erupting pheromones, Ning Manqing transformed into an Alpha in front of her.
“You smell so good, let me take a sniff.”
Li Chu: Where is my peerlessly beautiful Omega female lead???
associated_names: After Transmigrating Into the Book, I Got Marked by the Female Lead
穿书后我被女主标记了
穿書後我被女主标記了

120444.synopsis:
Jeong Yiwon was living his life running a guesthouse at Hae-un-dang, an old traditional house overlooking the sea.
Just as he was on the verge of selling it off for less than its worth, with his father’s debt tied to Hae-un-dang, he meets a man named Cha Seokju who comes to the house.
“Are you alone?”
“…Excuse me?”
“This guesthouse, I mean. I asked if you’re running the business by yourself.”
At first, he thought it was just a passing encounter,
“It’s hot. Got anything to drink?”
“There’s water.”
“I thought this was a guesthouse. You don’t sell coffee?”
“I don’t.”
“Give me water, then.”
And next, he thought the man would be a guest who would stay for a short while and leave. Until the man made a tempting offer.
“Give me a room.”
“……”
“Why the silence? Did you go out of business in the last few seconds?”
“…No.”
“Then take a customer.”
Yiwon, who was desperate for every penny, starts to show interest in the man’s offer.
“How many days will you be staying?”
“How would I know that?”
“I can only give you a room if you tell me a rough estimate.”
“Then let’s just say about a month.”
“Huh?”
“You don’t know what a month is? 30 days.”
In the end, he lets him into Hae-un-dang…

122492.synopsis: Uncle has returned… and plans to get rich with a food truck.

124284.synopsis:
When Ye Qinglan was a child, she had a childhood friend who was born on the exact same day, month, and year, but one hour later than her.
Unlike Ye Qinglan, who was lively, energetic, and loved to climb and explore, her childhood friend was soft, delicate, and always sickly.
Everyone believed that her friend would grow up to become an Omega, while Ye Qinglan would become an Alpha.
On their sixteenth birthday, the gentle girl made a quiet wish.
“I want to be with you forever, Jiejie.”
Unfortunately, the following year, a sudden accident forced her friend’s entire family to move overseas. Before leaving, she tearfully begged Ye Qinglan to wait for her. But after that, all contact was lost.
Years later, Ye Qinglan had become a celebrated actress, winning one prestigious award after another. Then, at one of her celebration parties, the childhood friend who had disappeared for years suddenly reappeared, now mature and confident.
With tears in her eyes, she cornered Ye Qinglan in the restroom and spoke with a trembling voice.
“Jiejie, I’m back. Please don’t be with anyone else.”
Ye Qinglan looked at her coldly and said, “Ning Yunshu, I am an Omega.”
Ning Yunshu blinked and replied softly, “That’s okay. I am an Alpha.”
Ye Qinglan was completely stunned.
After returning to the country, Ning Yunshu followed Ye Qinglan everywhere. She even persuaded Ye Qinglan’s mother to let her move into Ye Qinglan’s apartment.
On the very first night, Ye Qinglan set three clear rules.
“You are not allowed to stay in the same room with me at night. Do not bring up our childhood. And you are absolutely not allowed to enter my study.”
Ning Yunshu nodded quietly.
But one evening, as soon as Ye Qinglan walked through the door, she was overwhelmed by the sweet scent of milk candy filling the apartment. Unable to bear it any longer, she stormed toward the guest bedroom and threw the door open.
“Ning Yunshu, you…”
Inside, she found Ning Yunshu curled up in a corner, her eyes red and filled with tears. She was sobbing so hard that she could barely breathe. The moment she saw Ye Qinglan, she panicked.
“Jiejie, please don’t come in.”
Seeing her in such a fragile and scared state, Ye Qinglan’s heart softened once again.
She stepped forward, held the crying girl tightly, and exposed the back of her neck without hesitation.
“Be good. Don’t cry anymore.”
Later that night, Ning Yunshu held Ye Qinglan beneath her, her voice low and hoarse.
“Jiejie, why won’t you let me into your study?”
Ye Qinglan blushed and turned her head away.
“Because…”
That room held every piece of her youth and all the secret feelings she had ever had for Ning Yunshu.
A soft-hearted CEO with the scent of milk candy and a quiet crybaby personality.
A cold and elegant actress with the scent of roses.
Alpha and Omega, but not in the typical way.
This is not your usual ABO story.
One-line Summary:
The CEO from the actress’s past has come back and she is crying again.
Theme:
What you never stop longing for will one day come back to you.

130172.synopsis:
Liang Huan was an emperor. He spent thirty years unifying the world, only to die from overwork and transmigrate to a world several hundred years in the future.
His uncle told him that in a few hundred years, people would live peaceful and happy lives, with no worries about food or clothing, where everyone was equal.
He stood in a barren desert. In front of him were mountain-sized spaceships and rockets, and behind him were twisted zombies and ferocious heteromorphs. Then, he was kicked to the ground.
A tall, long-legged man with sharp features had a cigarette dangling from his lips. His heavy boot pressed down on Liang Huan’s fair face as he sneered, “Little bastard, where do you think you’re running?”
Liang Huan blinked slowly and severed the man’s Achilles tendon.
Li Yao, the number one mercenary in Earth’s Eastern District, almost became a cripple on the very first day he got a “wife.”
He looked at the pretty boy he had tied up like a crab, the tip of his knife lifting the other’s chin. “If you didn’t know how to pilot a mecha, do you think I would have traded three gold medals for you?”
Liang Huan was a little bewildered.
“Tell your husband, what kind of mechas can you pilot?” Li Yao patted his fair, tender cheek with the flat of his knife.
Liang Huan’s expression didn’t change. “Zhen can pilot them all.”
(Note: 朕 (Zhèn) is the imperial pronoun for “I,” used by emperors.)
Li Yao: “…”
And then, the only remaining 3S-class mecha on Earth was sunk into the East China Sea.
Pairing: An emperor who specializes in curing all kinds of defiance (Gong/Top) × A conceited, arrogant, and badass king of mercenaries (Shou/Bottom)
Liang Huan × Li Yao

136572.synopsis: [Please forget about me.] Safinia Estman was a noble daughter born from a maid. Because of that, unlike her other brothers and sisters, she was coldly treated by everyone. Her only friend was Hestia, the count’s daughter and Safinia’s childhood friend, who became her lady-in-waiting when she was ten. Time passed, and the year Safinia turned eighteen, her father suddenly ordered her to be engaged. The match was Gilbert, the third son of a count. The Estman family arranged the engagement to pawn off and get rid of the inconvenient Safinia. Still, for the lonely Safinia, the engagement news was a great joy. Gilbert was a very kind young man, and Safinia quickly fell in love. As she continued to spend time with Gilbert, often bringing Hestia along, she realized the two of them were in love with each other. Wishing for their happiness, Safinia decided to fake her own death and vanish from everyone’s lives; she carried out the plan and left the duke’s mansion. Thus, Safinia’s new life began—
associated_names: 孤独な公女～私は死んだことにしてください

140156.synopsis:
The Immortal Dao towers above. Gods and demons look down upon the mortal world. yaos and demons rampage unchecked…
Stumbling into this realm, Lin Zheyu discovers a truth: Heaven Rewards the Diligent. As long as he works hard enough, he can grow stronger.
So what if the Immortal Dao is unreachable? So what if gods and demons cannot be gazed upon directly? So what if yaos and demons run rampant?
Lin Zheyu embarks on the path of martial cultivation. He remains steady and humble, diligent and relentless in training, step by step forging a road to immortality that belongs to him alone.
Summary:
The story follows Lin Zheyu, a man transported into a world of martial cultivation. Unlike many protagonists who rely on luck, destiny, or fortuitous encounters, he discovers a different truth: Heaven Rewards the Diligent.
Through discipline, persistence, and relentless training, he grows stronger. Steady, low-key, and unwavering, he forges a road to longevity that belongs to him alone.
If you enjoy cultivation stories that emphasize effort over shortcuts, resilience over luck, and martial growth built brick by brick, then this is a journey worth following.

143740.synopsis:
Lin Xi is an office drone drowning in the relentless grind of a 996/007 world, working day and night yet still unable to afford even a bathroom in this exorbitantly expensive city.
One night, after returning from a client dinner, she mysteriously finds herself added to a WeChat group.
Someone @’s her, claiming to have traveled to another world and begging her to check on their parents, offering ten taels of gold as payment.
Thinking it’s just a joke, Lin Xi agrees—only for several golden peanuts to materialize before her eyes the next second…
Soon, more bizarre requests flood the group.
A user from a post-apocalyptic world asks her to investigate their own death, offering gene-repair serums and advanced weapons as reward.
Another, stranded in a primitive era, pleads for her to adopt their pet orange cat, promising rare gemstones in return.
A third, trapped in ancient times, tasks her with uncovering the truth behind their mu*der to bring the killer to justice, with payment ranging from forbidden palace gossip and concubine scheming manuals to lost literary masterpieces and legendary paintings.
……
Lin Xi: Say no more! I’m totally in—this is no trouble at all!
———-

147324.synopsis:
Due to family circumstances, Luo Chenxuan moved seven times with his parents since childhood, which left him with almost no close friends.
Except… for that beam of light that shone into his heart during each move… 
Was it really light?
In truth, it was… fear. 
That fear was carved deep in his heart, unforgettable for life.
“Why? Why does this happen every time we move?”
“You thought I couldn’t find you?”
“Do you still remember the promise we made as kids?”
“You said you’d marry me when you grow up, you haven’t forgotten, right?”
“Who exactly do you like?”
“Come to me now, and I’ll forgive you.”
“Are you planning to defy me?”
“Brother~ you’ll choose me, won’t you?”
associated_names: 搬家七次，七位病嬌青梅還在追我

154236.synopsis:
“So, Mr. Seo Yi-joo, what is your answer?”
“….Yes, yes?”
“Are you alright with marrying me?”
It was a blind date he attended in place of his younger sibling. A date that was unsuitable for an illegitimate child of the RU Group.
“If I am acceptable to you, yes, I… I am fine with marrying you.”
There, Seo Yi-joo met Ki Tae-wook, the executive director of Jae-seung Construction, and was unexpectedly proposed to.
The decision was easy.
If he married him, he could escape the tormenting house and his family. Even if it was only for a very short time. Even if it was only until Ki Tae-wook grew tired of him, a recessive omega.
“Who do you think I am?”
“Tae-wook-ssi…?”
“And where is this?” ”
Uh… a hotel.”
“What is behind your back, Seo Yi-joo-ssi?”
“….The bed?”
“You know everything perfectly well.”
Living like a mouse, and never crossing the other person’s mood. Knowing his place was what Seo Yi-joo was best at. But then.
“More than anything… I’m afraid that you might be disappointed because it seems like I’m not considering your position, Tae-wook-ssi.”
 “….”
“But if you truly think I don’t need to worry about things like that… then, if I’m being honest. Actually, I, Tae-wook-ssi…”
 “….”
“…I wish you would stay with me.”
Why was this person so kind to him?
In the face of a warmth he had never received in his entire life, he no longer wanted to leave his side, where he was only meant to stay briefly. He shouldn’t feel this way, not knowing his own place.

155516.synopsis:
Qin Yuzhen, codename “Salted Fish (Slacker).”
She had won the “Outstanding Missionary” award for a hundred consecutive years.
A master at flirting with women and men alike.
Every moment of every day, she was up to no good.
But this time, she had become the victim of someone else’s scheme.
Qin Yuzhen had been manipulated into becoming the vengeful villainess in a book.
That twisted, wealthy heiress with a dark heart.
The former Grand Princess, who had played the female lead in five centuries of stories, now wanted nothing more than to quickly destroy this world and return to the System.
Yet she discovered that this fake heiress was rather intriguing.
The fake heiress was beautiful, with a voice sweet enough to melt hearts. How could anyone resist such a girl when she acted spoiled?
“Zhenzhen, why are you smiling at that girl? Am I not pretty enough?”
“Zhenzhen, I heard you secretly called him last night!”
“Zhenzhen, Zhenzhen, do you not like me anymore?”
Slacker sighed. “I do like you. I like you the most. When you act spoiled, I’d even give you my life.”
She had always believed she had tamed the fake heiress, but in the end, she realized she was the one who had been tamed.
*****
This fast-paced story features a protagonist with genuine and nuanced emotions, making it well worth a read.

180860.synopsis:
After transmigrating into a sword-and-magic fantasy world, while other adventurers are still busy learning skills and hunting monsters to upgrade their gear, Luxin discovers something different—every time he kills a monster, he can randomly extract one of its abilities.
But… why are the abilities getting weirder and more embarrassing…?
“Defeated a low-level monster Slime. Obtained [Liquid Manipulation] …”
associated_names: 说好的魔物能力，怎么是羞耻技能

204668.synopsis:
I transmigrated into a BL novel.
There was only one problem.
My role was the secondary top who would spend his entire life alone, harboring an unrequited love for the main bottom.
You have died.
Would you like to restart?
The system forces me to love him and gives me penalties whenever my Affection Level drops.
As if that weren’t enough, it even presents me with games that require me to risk my life.
Countless repeated deaths and resets.
I struggled desperately to raise the Affection Level and stay alive.
If I could become the perfect side top, I was willing to abandon ‘myself.’
Hope remained impossibly distant.
And as time passed, the people around me slowly began to change.
The protagonists who are supposed to love each other say they love me.
Even the supporting characters beg me for my love.
……How did things end up like this?
associated_names: Transmigrated as the Side Top used as an Emotional T*ash Can
